text: きのみのもりに　いけば　いくつか　おちて　いるわよ

structure.jp: きのみのもりに　いけば
structure.en: if you go to Berry Forest

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if'. いけば = 'if you go'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている here shows the state left after something happened: they fell and are still there. おちて　いる = 'are lying (fallen) on the ground'.
